summary: In the main deck, a diagram appears on the screen ('The diagram windows onto the screen.'). Tank confirms receipt ('Got it.'), and Morpheus, heard as a voice-over, immediately requests 'the main wet-wall' ('MORPHEUS (V.O.) / I need the main wet-wall.'). The scene is a brief exchange in which Tank loads a structural visual and Morpheus specifies the next thing he needs.

what_changes.before: Working from Morpheus's earlier order to find a structural drawing, Tank is still locating the right image.
what_changes.after: Tank has the structural diagram up on screen and acknowledges it, then receives a more specific target from Morpheus.
what_changes.evidence: The diagram windows onto the screen. TANK Got it. MORPHEUS (V.O.) I need the main wet-wall.

event_hint.one_line: While the police close in, Tank feeds Morpheus the building's structural plans so the trapped crew can find a way out.
